newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 17.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MARCH 17.

text.p: These were the headlines on Estonian Kuku radio at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Williams de Broe investment firm recommends international investors to buy stocks on Baltic stock markets, citing quick economic growth as incentive to invest.
- Police investigator thinks more people are involved in last week's double-killing in Tallinn. Two suspects have been brought in for questioning and will be charged later this week.
- Great Britain faces new food scare; parents urged to carefully wash fruits to rid of harmful pesticides.
